headline: Unable to discover deployed contract addresses for Dswap on ENI

findings.text: ENI block explorer (scan.eniac.network) could not be accessed via direct fetch; unable to perform name-tag search for 'Dswap' on canonical ENI explorer.
Protocol website (https://daoaas.io/swap) returned minimal HTML with no deployed addresses or documentation links; info dashboard (https://info.daoaas.io/) requires JavaScript execution.
No audit links are recorded in per-protocol context; no audit PDFs were fetched.

Protocol.github is null in per-protocol context. Search found https://github.com/thirdfi/dao-swap-contracts, but this repository is archived (Mar 17, 2023), is a fork of bnb-chain/eth-bsc-swap-contracts, and documents ETH-BSC cross-chain swaps, not an ENI DEX. Repository does not contain deployment artifacts for ENI chain.
Protocol is pinned to single chain (ENI); no multi-chain enumeration required.

rationale.verdict: No contract addresses could be discovered. The primary website yields no on-chain links; the block explorer is inaccessible; the GitHub repo found is archived, unrelated (ETH-BSC swaps, not ENI), and contains no ENI deployment data. Discovery cannot proceed without access to one of: (a) a working block explorer, (b) a canonical deployment documentation page, (c) an accessible GitHub repo with deployment artifacts, or (d) audit PDFs with address tables.

evidence.shows: Protocol website returns minimal HTML; no contract addresses, deployment docs, or documentation links visible. Fetch yielded only meta tags and title.

Repository is archived as of Mar 17, 2023. Fork of bnb-chain/eth-bsc-swap-contracts. README documents ETH-to-BSC cross-chain token swaps via ETHSwapAgent and BSCSwapAgent. No ENI chain deployments, no migration artifacts for ENI.
